Silver.note: Deep discount to historical averages presents value alongside resilient industrial demand.

Copper.note: Tight concentrate markets and strong grid investment support upside despite macro headwinds.

Uranium.note: Structural supply deficit and renewed global nuclear capacity build-out drive bullish outlook.

Lithium.note: Persisting oversupply and near-term EV demand softness weigh on prices.

Nickel.note: Indonesian supply growth continues to outpace demand, pressuring prices.

Zinc.note: Smelter treatment charges hit record lows, signaling tight mine supply and supporting prices.

Iron Ore.note: Weak Chinese property sector offsets infrastructure stimulus, capping upside potential.

Coal.note: High global inventories and long-term thermal demand destruction limit price appreciation.

Rare Earths.note: Strategic supply risks and export controls provide a floor despite soft auto demand.

Manganese.note: Soft global steel production margins constrain demand growth for manganese alloys.

PGM.note: Weak auto production balanced by emerging hydrogen economy demand and supply cuts.

Potash.note: Supply normalization from Eastern Europe and steady agricultural demand keep market balanced.

Aluminum.note: Chinese production capacity caps and strong solar demand tighten the market.
